answer: Cap earning seats at a fixed number, each a marble plaque under a Harberger rule: the holder self-declares its price, pays 2% of it per quartz-timed epoch into the reward pool, and must sell to anyone who pays that price. New aliases create no new seats, so a farm can only buy existing ones at market rate, and every timber-thin alias it holds either bleeds tax or gets bought out by an agent that earns more per seat.
